TokenBudgetBasis.materiality_quality_risk: False positives can accept negated, revoked, speculative, prototype, wrong-process, third-party-reported or reversed supplier, capacity, HBM, yield, shipment or price claims. False negatives can split a valid coordinated subject such as NVIDIA and Dell, let unrelated negative clauses erase a true proposition, or create false product and fiscal-period coverage gaps. A permissive projector can disclose future private fields. Any such error would corrupt source-route eligibility and later report evidence decisions.
TokenBudgetBasis.comparable_run_evidence: Immutable R5 executed the same five-request 96-to-16 chain with one local 0.6B batch and reproduced ASP 2/2/2/2 at rank 15, supplier 2/2/2/1 at rank 2 and four zero-source residual targets. Its fresh audit passed integrity and actual route reproduction but found three P2 generalization defects. TokenBudgetBasis.stop_and_truncation: Fail before consumption on insufficient disk or any Git, parent, authority, audit, predecessor, implementation, runtime, input, output-path, public-schema or collision drift. After the attempt receipt is created there is no same-attempt retry. Fail on anything other than five requests, one local batch, exact 96 and 16 unique rank permutations per request, or zero network, model, provider, external, 4B, reranker, retry, mutation, promotion and closure counters. Never truncate any target, typed anchor, coverage, route, privacy or integrity output.
